card.opportunity_illinois: Advance to Illinois Avenue. Collect $300 if you pass Go.
card.opportunity_st_charles: Advance to St. Charles Place. Collect $300 if you pass Go.
card.opportunity_nearest_utility: Advance to the nearest utility. If owned, roll and pay ten times the result.
card.opportunity_nearest_transport: Advance to the nearest railroad and pay double rent if owned.
card.opportunity_nearest_transport_2: Advance to the nearest railroad and pay double rent if owned.
card.opportunity_reading: Go to Reading Railroad. Collect $300 if you pass Go.
card.opportunity_jail: Go directly to Jail. Do not pass Go or collect $300.
card.opportunity_jail_free: Get out of Jail free. Keep this card until needed or sold.
card.opportunity_repairs: Make general repairs. Pay $25 per house and $100 per hotel.
card.opportunity_chairman: You were elected chairman. Pay each player $50.
card.opportunity_crossword: You won a crossword competition. Collect $100.
card.opportunity_pay_or_draw: Pay a $10 fine or draw another Chance card. The server applies the fine.
card.opportunity_nearest_auction: Go back to the nearest Auction space and resolve it.
card.opportunity_rate_adjustment: Rate adjustment. Pay $300 with three or more complete groups; otherwise collect $100.
card.opportunity_advance_five: Advance five spaces. Buy an unowned property at a 10% discount.
card.community_bank_error: Bank error in your favor. Collect $200.
card.community_jail_free: Get out of Jail free. Keep this card until needed or sold.
card.community_jail: Go directly to Jail. Do not pass Go or collect $300.
card.community_opera: Grand opera night. Collect $50 from every player.
card.community_collect_each: It is your birthday. Collect $10 from every player.
card.community_repairs: Street repairs. Pay $40 per house and $115 per hotel.
card.community_beauty: You won second prize in a beauty contest. Collect $10.
card.community_audit: Bank audit. Pay $25 for every property you own.
card.community_renewal_subsidy: Urban renewal subsidy. Collect $50 per mortgaged property.
card.community_refinance: Refinancing pays the principal, without the 10% interest, on the highest-value mortgage you can lift.
